name: labels-rework
title: Labels rework: renamable pinned segments + selection-driven form
description: Issue #189 follow-ups on the merged Labels list (grilled): (1) pinned segments renamable - name-only, pencil opens existing label form with Name editable + Start/Range/Color read-only; rename persists via segmentNames map (startAddress -> name) inside the labels payload; custom name displayed, parsed name in tooltip. (2) All label rows display range as start-end-size (segment style). (3) Label form click-to-fill: focus-aware (last-focused field receives hex clicks; Range focused auto-switches to End addr + fills) plus drag-fill (selection change updates Start + Range per mode); never stomps manual input. Out of scope: max-length labels, delete/hide/color for pinned rows.
